prompt: Wide shot across a vast dark quarry pit. Far across the quarry, embedded in the towering layered rock-strata wall, is an enormous flat fossil slab: the complete skeleton of a colossal horned beast pressed sideways into the grey slate, a dark stone imprint at the same level as the rock, NOT three-dimensional. Stepped quarry ledges and rubble lead down to it; tiny scale cues make the fossil read as ENORMOUS, dwarfing the surroundings. A cold blue-white necromantic glow traces a mineral seam running across the slab and through the strata. Deep mine quarry, colorless earthen palette.
